This old-world military maintenance depot lies outside River Valley City, within a day's round trip on foot. Assign 4 registered adult workers to rotating shifts. They remain on the local population register and retain their daily ration allocations; field rations require special approval. This work must never take workers away from regular production, municipal construction, school teaching, or medical care. Halt work whenever labor or food is short. Pausing exploration does not refund materials already spent.

Perimeter survey procedure: expenditure of local wood 20, food 20, tools 8, medicine 4; total work required: 180 worker-seconds. Survey the surrounding geology and radiation levels before digging deeper. This yields no unearned windfall or population gains from nowhere.

Mutant hard-shelled beetles nest in the residual warmth of geothermal pipe trenches. When strangers approach, they become agitated and form ranks to defend their eggs. Guided relocation: expenditure of wood 20, food 16; work required: 240 worker-seconds. Lay a pheromone scent trail leading to an abandoned ditch. Reinforced containment: expenditure of iron 12, tools 6; work required: 180 worker-seconds. Seal the nest fissures with iron-reinforced fill and shore up a separate excavation passage. Either choice is fully recorded in the site archives.

The depot holds only a few sealed reserves and 1 old maintenance robot with completely seized servo joints. Preservation: expenditure of parts 8, tools 4; work required: 300 worker-seconds. Clear and recover knowledge 40, glass 12, mechanical parts 12, and secure 1 damaged maintenance robot in storage. The robot is not yet usable. Dismantling: expenditure of tools 6; work required: 180 worker-seconds. Cut apart and salvage steel 20, parts 30; the robot's frame is not preserved. These choices are mutually exclusive, and this site can only be completed once. Neither choice directly grants mass-production technology.
